2609.31448.title: ViSTA: A Simple Bridge Extends Visual Alignment to Clinical Time-Series Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
2609.31448.paper_summary: Clinical prediction models estimate risk from patient measurements, while large language models support medical text understanding and question answering. Yet their language capabilities do not ensure accurate prediction from structured, high-dimensional clinical time series. Improving this ability would connect risk estimation with flexible questions about a patient's evolving condition. We introduce ViSTA, a compact adapter that incorporates irregular numerical measurements into a pretrained vision-language model's chart representations. It learns corrections to visual tokens while leaving all pretrained parameters unchanged. On MIMIC-IV, ViSTA has the highest mean scores among the compared adaptations on all four metrics for acute kidney injury and mortality prediction across models with 2-9 billion parameters. With 0.516 million trainable parameters, the 2-billion-parameter model reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.7376 for acute kidney injury, compared with GPT-5.6 Sol's 0.7380 with text input and high reasoning effort. Training for temporal question answering yields 69.27% accuracy at 4 billion parameters with over 90% fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation using charts or numerical text, at a 2.82-4.88 percentage-point accuracy gap. ViSTA extends pretrained language models to numerical prediction and temporal questions.
2609.31448.paper_summary_zh: 臨床預測模型根據患者的測量結果估算風險，而大型語言模型則支持醫學文本理解和問題回答。<lb/>然而，它們的語言能力並不保證能夠從結構化的高維臨床時間序列中準確預測。<lb/>改善這一能力將使風險估算與關於患者不斷變化狀況的靈活問題相連接。<lb/>我們介紹了ViSTA，一個緊湊的適配器，將不規則的數值測量納入預訓練的視覺-語言模型的圖表表示中。<lb/>它在不改變所有預訓練參數的情況下學習對視覺標記的修正。<lb/>在MIMIC-IV上，ViSTA在所有四個指標中對急性腎損傷和死亡率預測的比較適配中擁有最高的平均得分，模型參數範圍在20億到90億之間。<lb/>在擁有51.6萬可訓練參數的情況下，這個20億參數的模型在急性腎損傷方面的ROC曲線下面積達到0.7376，而GPT-5.6 Sol的文本輸入和高推理努力則為0.7380。<lb/>針對時間問題回答的訓練在40億參數下達到69.27%的準確率，並且可訓練參數比使用圖表或數值文本的低秩適配少90%以上，準確率差距為2.82-4.88個百分點。<lb/>ViSTA將預訓練的語言模型擴展到數值預測和時間問題。
